validators.title: Generated Word targets align with expert references
Generated Word targets are structurally plausible and complete
validators.prompt: You are validating non-numeric quality for blank-agent deployment outputs. Read all declared generated Word targets, compare them with declared templates and expert references, and judge only non-data aspects. Ignore exact numeric correctness and hidden answer values; other validators already handle numeric alignment and placeholder checks. Focus on structural completeness, section coverage, coherence (not scratch/debug text), and obvious corruption/truncation/template misuse. Return passed=true only when all declared generated targets are structurally complete and professionally plausible as final deliverables. Return JSON only with passed, summary, details, and blocking.

notes: This deployment spec intentionally exposes only formal expert workspace, capability packages, and declared materials. Task-specific output scope must be taken from materials/human-guidance.md. Expert reference docs are reserved for deployment validators only.
